pin_kinds.graph_content_sha256: REQUIRED. Content fingerprint of outputs/brainlab/malecns_v1/graph.npz, which the user generates with brainlab.prepare. Scheme neurofly-npz-content-v1: sha256 of b'neurofly-npz-content-v1\0' || u64 member count, then for each member sorted by name (.npy suffix removed): u64-length-prefixed UTF-8 name || u64-length-prefixed numpy little-endian dtype string ('<i8', '<i4', '<f4') || u64 ndim || u64 per dimension || values in C order as fixed-width little-endian bytes (NaN canonicalised). u64 = unsigned 64-bit little-endian. Zip headers (timestamp, host OS, zip64 extras) and the .npy header text are not content. Implemented by brainlab.graph_identity.npz_content_sha256.
pin_kinds.neuron_map_content_sha256: REQUIRED. Content fingerprint of connectome_data/malecns_v1/normalized/neurons.feather, which the user generates with brainlab.connectome. Scheme neurofly-table-content-v1: sha256 of b'neurofly-table-content-v1\0' || u64 n_rows || u64 n_columns, then for every column in file order: u64-length-prefixed UTF-8 name || u64-length-prefixed dtype tag ('bool', 'int8'..'uint64', 'float16'..'float64', or 'utf8' for string/large_string/string_view) || n_rows null-mask bytes (1 = null) || values with nulls replaced by zero/empty: bool as n_rows bytes 0/1; integers and floats as fixed-width little-endian (NaN canonicalised); utf8 as n_rows u64 byte lengths followed by the concatenated UTF-8 bytes. Schema metadata (which records the pandas and pyarrow versions), chunking and string offset width are not content; names, order, dtype, nullness and values are. Implemented by brainlab.graph_identity.table_content_sha256.
pin_kinds.graph_sha256: Reference identifier: sha256 of the reference graph.npz bytes (Linux, numpy 2.x). Carried by every receipt, checkpoint and server status as the graph identity, and reported only after graph_content_sha256 has matched. NOT required of the local file: on Linux the bytes reproduce exactly, but zipfile writes a different host-OS byte on Windows.
pin_kinds.neuron_map_sha256: LEGACY reference identifier: sha256 of the reference neurons.feather bytes, written by pandas 3.0.5 / pyarrow 25.0.1. NOT required of the local file: pandas records its own version in the feather schema metadata, so pandas 3.0.6 writes the same table as 416b4a36... and pandas 2.2 as aafe71aa.... Verification uses neuron_map_content_sha256.
pin_kinds.ids_sha256: Content digest of graph.npz ids as little-endian int64 (already content-based).
pin_kinds.source_sha256: Byte sha256 of the three MaleCNS tables users DOWNLOAD from storage.googleapis.com; the server fixes their bytes, so a byte pin is correct. edges.feather (1 GB) is checked at download (brainlab.download) and not rehashed by verify_graph.
